name: hl-create-design-video
description: Records the explainer video from the running app (decision 0028).

scripts.video:check: node lines.mjs --check storyboard.json && node lines.mjs --check storyboard-dahl.json
scripts.video:demo: playwright test --grep @demo && node cues.mjs out/demo && node compose.mjs out/demo
scripts.video:dahl: playwright test --grep @dahl && node cues.mjs out/dahl && node compose.mjs out/dahl --cut-gaps --readme
scripts.video:groq: playwright test --grep @groq && node cues.mjs out/groq && node compose.mjs out/groq --cut-gaps --readme
